fact: The OGP Malawi Secretariat announced on 2025-09-03 that Malawi had officially launched its new Open Data Portal, giving citizens access to government budget, development project and public service delivery data through dashboards and downloadable datasets, as part of the Third OGP National Action Plan; the document names no publishing ministry or dataset count and does not tie the portal to an open data policy.

The MWEITI open data policy says that after its first open data policy of December 2016 MWEITI started producing a summary data sheet and publishing it on the MWEITI website; as_of is that December 2016 policy date, the start date being not stated precisely.
